    13	" Function to generate the layout recreation script
    14	function! s:LayoutQuine(output_path) abort
    15	    let script_lines = []
    16	    
    17	    " Add header
    18	    call add(script_lines, '" Auto-generated Vim layout recreation script')
    19	    call add(script_lines, '" Generated by LayoutQuine plugin')
    20	    call add(script_lines, '')
    21	    
    22	    " Get current tab information
    23	    let current_tab = tabpagenr()
    24	    let total_tabs = tabpagenr('$')
    25	    
    26	    " Store tab information
    27	    let tabs_info = []
    28	    for tab_num in range(1, total_tabs)
    29	        let tab_info = {
    30	            \ 'tabnr': tab_num,
    31	            \ 'windows': [],
    32	            \ 'active': (tab_num == current_tab)
    33	            \ }
    34	        
    35	        " Get window count for this tab
    36	        let win_count = tabpagewinnr(tab_num, '$')
    37	        
    38	        " Get window layout using winlayout()
    39	        let layout = tabpagewinlayout(tab_num)
    40	        
    41	        " Get buffers for each window
    42	        for win_num in range(1, win_count)
    43	            let bufnr = tabpagebuflist(tab_num)[win_num - 1]
    44	            let bufname = bufname(bufnr)
    45	            let bufnr_num = bufnr(bufname)

    47	            call add(tab_info.windows, {
    48	                \ 'winnr': win_num,
    49	                \ 'bufnr': bufnr,
    50	                \ 'bufname': bufname
    51	                \ })
    52	        endfor

    54	        call add(tabs_info, tab_info)
    55	    endfor
    56	    
    57	    " Generate script to recreate tabs and windows
    58	    call add(script_lines, '" Restore tabs and windows')
    59	    
    60	    " Always start with tab 1 (exists by default)
    61	    call add(script_lines, 'tabfirst')
    62

    64	    for tab_info in tabs_info

    69	        endif
    70

    73	            call add(script_lines, 'tabnext ' . tab_info.tabnr)
    74	        endif
    75	        
    76	        " Recreate windows for this tab
    77	        if len(tab_info.windows) > 1
    78	            call add(script_lines, '')
    79	            call add(script_lines, '" Recreate ' . len(tab_info.windows) . ' windows in tab ' . tab_info.tabnr)

    81	            " Get the layout tree for this tab

    95	            call add(script_lines, '" Navigate to active window ' . active_winnnr)
    96	            call add(script_lines, 'wincmd ' . active_winnr . 'w')

   113	" Parse the layout tree and extract window information
   114	function! s:ParseLayoutTree(layout, tabnr) abort
   115	    let result = []
   116	    
   117	    if type(a:layout) == type([])
   118	        if a:layout[0] ==# 'window'
   119	            " This is a window node
   120	            " Format: ['window', bufnr, ...]
   121	            if len(a:layout) >= 2
   122	                let bufnr = a:layout[1]
   123	                let bufname = bufname(bufnr)
   124	                call add(result, {
   125	                    \ 'type': 'window',
   126	                    \ 'bufnr': bufnr,
   127	                    \ 'bufname': bufname,
   128	                    \ 'tabnr': a:tabnr
   129	                    \ })
   130	            endif
   131	        else
   132	            " This is a container node ('vsplit' or 'split')
   133	            " Format: ['vsplit'/'split', left_child, right_child, ...]
   134	            let orientation = a:layout[0]
   135	            for i in range(1, len(a:layout) - 1)
   136	                let child_result = s:ParseLayoutTree(a:layout[i], a:tabnr)
   137	                if orientation ==# 'vsplit'
   138	                    call add(result, {'type': 'vsplit'})
   139	                else
   140	                    call add(result, {'type': 'split'})
   141	                endif
   142	                call extend(result, child_result)
   143	            endfor
   144	        endif
   145	    endif
   146	    
   147	    return result
   148	endfunction

   150	" Recreate windows based on parsed layout
   151	function! s:RecreateWindows(script_lines, window_order, windows_info) abort
   152	    if len(a:window_order) == 0
   153	        return
   154	    endif
   155	    
   156	    let first_window = 1
   157	    let win_idx = 0
   158	    
   159	    for item in a:window_order
   160	        if item.type ==# 'window'
   161	            " This is a window, set its buffer
   162	            if win_idx < len(a:windows_info)
   163	                let bufname = a:windows_info[win_idx].bufname
   164	                if bufname != ''
   165	                    call add(a:script_lines, 'edit ' . fnameescape(bufname))
   166	                endif
   167	                let win_idx += 1
   168	            endif
   169	        elseif item.type ==# 'vsplit'
   170	            " Create a vertical split
   171	            call add(a:script_lines, 'vsplit')
   172	        elseif item.type ==# 'split'
   173	            " Create a horizontal split
   174	            call add(a:script_lines, 'split')
   175	        endif
   176	    endfor
   177	endfunction

   273	" Analyze the layout tree to extract split information
   274	function! s:AnalyzeLayout(layout) abort
   275	    let result = []
   276	    
   277	    if type(a:layout) != type([])
   278	        return result
   279	    endif
   280	    
   281	    if a:layout[0] ==# 'window'
   282	        " Single window
   283	        call add(result, {'type': 'window'})
   284	    else
   285	        " Container node with splits
   286	        let orientation = a:layout[0]
   287	        call add(result, {'type': orientation})
   288	        
   289	        for i in range(1, len(a:layout) - 1)
   290	            let child_result = s:AnalyzeLayout(a:layout[i])
   291	            call extend(result, child_result)
   292	        endfor
   293	    endif
   294	    
   295	    return result
   296	endfunction

   298	" Recreate windows from analyzed layout
   299	function! s:RecreateWindowsFromLayout(script_lines, split_info, windows_info) abort
   300	    let win_idx = 0
   301	    let split_idx = 0
   302	    
   303	    " First window already exists
   304	    if win_idx < len(a:windows_info)
   305	        let bufname = a:windows_info[win_idx].bufname
   306	        if bufname != ''
   307	            call add(a:script_lines, 'edit ' . fnameescape(bufname))
   308	        endif
   309	        let win_idx += 1
   310	    endif
   311	    
   312	    " Process splits and additional windows
   313	    while split_idx < len(a:split_info) && win_idx < len(a:windows_info)
   314	        let item = a:split_info[split_idx]
   315	        
   316	        if item.type ==# 'vsplit'
   317	            call add(a:script_lines, 'vsplit')
   318	        elseif item.type ==# 'split'
   319	            call add(a:script_lines, 'split')
   320	        endif
   321	        
   322	        " Set buffer for the new window
   323	        let bufname = a:windows_info[win_idx].bufname
   324	        if bufname != ''
   325	            call add(a:script_lines, 'edit ' . fnameescape(bufname))
   326	        endif
   327	        
   328	        let win_idx += 1
   329	        let split_idx += 1
   330	    endwhile
